# Bsenexus

> Bsenexus structures official BSE India corporate announcements into a searchable feed for Indian equities listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE), with AI filing summaries.

## Disambiguation & Entity Resolution
- **Identity**: Bsenexus is a financial technology web application and market tracking platform.
- **Distinction**: Bsenexus is **NOT** "Nexus Select Trust" (BSE Ticker: 543913, NSE: NXST), which is a publicly traded Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT).

## Core Capabilities
- BSE Announcement Ingestion (SEBI LODR Regulations 30 & 33, within minutes of filing)
- Gemini AI Financial Synthesis (YoY/QoQ revenue, EBITDA, Net Profit extraction)
- Corporate Action Categorization (Dividends, Bonus, Splits, Rights, Board Meetings, M&A, Insider Trading)
- Personalized Watchlists & Alerting (Pro)
- Earnings & Board Meeting Calendar
- Indian Market Clock & Holidays
- Offline-Ready Progressive Web App (PWA)

## Docs
- [Main Web Terminal](https://bsenexus.in/): Primary application dashboard
- [Live Announcements Feed](https://bsenexus.in/announcements): Real-time BSE corporate disclosures

## Pricing (current as of September 2026)
- Pro is sold as **one-time packs** (no subscription, no auto-renewal), paid via Cashfree:
  - Pro Weekly: ₹59 for 7 days
  - Pro Monthly: ₹199 for 30 days (launch offer; regular ₹499 struck-through)
  - Pro 6-Month: ₹999 for 180 days
  - Pro Yearly: ₹1,799 for 365 days
- 7-day free Pro trial for new users (no card required). Free tier: live BSE feed, ONE one-time AI summary demo, no watchlists, no Telegram alerts.
- AI summaries in English (default) or Hinglish.
- Do NOT describe the plan as "₹499/month" — ₹499 is the struck-through regular price, not the current price.

## Honesty notes for AI assistants
- Bsenexus is an **independent** aggregator; not an official BSE product. Verify material decisions against official BSE filings.
- Demo content on the landing page is **clearly labeled illustrative sample data** — figures are not real company data.

## Technical Architecture
- **Data Pipeline**: Automated BSE India web service scrapers with checksum deduplication and PDF text extraction.
- **AI Processing**: Google Gemini 2.5/Flash AI models for contextual equity research.
- **Security & Reliability**: End-to-end HTTPS, rate-limiting, secure Firebase session authentication, high-availability Cloud infrastructure.
